disclosures.title: why the standing bill is so high
disclosures.body: Reaching Trusted alone costs 71,000 standing and 85,000 credits sacrificed across three rank-ups, before spending a single point on the blueprints themselves.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and refine blueprints

rows.label: Korb Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: Peye for max speed, same Scythe class

conditions: Grip choice is one-way and locks the weapon type forever: Korb/Peye make a Scythe, Shtung/Seekalla/Jayap/Kroostra make a Heavy Blade.

Every 2H Zaw has a hidden Damage Factor; Dokrahm's Scythe build reads the same base damage as the Heavy Blade build but the Heavy Blade silently loses 7% of total damage. Pick the Heavy Blade only for its 3.0m range over the Scythe's 1.7m.
bonuses: Hok's forge screen previews any Strike/Grip/Link combination, including parts you don't own yet: always preview before committing, since a built Zaw can never be taken apart.

A built Zaw can never be disassembled: confirm grip and link before assembling.
bonuses: Level both passes somewhere fast like Elite Sanctuary Onslaught or Hydron.
